content.title: WATCH: Trump address on Iran
content.text: Updated April 1, 2026 8:47pm EDT Trump's Iran address: 'Winning bigger than ever before' WASHINGTON - The president is expected to address the nation with a live update on the ongoing war in Iran from the White House on Wednesday night. White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt posted to X on Tuesday, "TUNE IN: Tomorrow night at 9PM ET, President Trump will give an Address to the Nation to provide an important update on Iran." What time is Trump's address? President Trump's address to the nation is scheduled to be from 9 p.m. to 9:20 p.m. on Wednesday night. How to watch the address FOX 5 DC will be live-streaming the coverage, starting from 9 p.m. You can watch the president's address live on the FOX LOCAL app, on the FOX 5 DC YouTube channel and the FOX 5 DC TikTok account. Iran war latest Tom Fitzgerald sits down with Daniella Cheslow, a Politico national security reporter, to discuss the latest with the Iran war. The backstory: The war in Iran is continuing into the second month On Wednesday morning, the president posted to the platform Truth Social, that Iran's new leader has asked for a ceasefire. "Iran’s New Regime President, much less Radicalized and far more intelligent than his predecessors, has just asked the United States of America for a CEASEFIRE! We will consider when Hormuz Strait is open, free, and clear. Until then, we are blasting Iran into oblivion or, as they say, back to the Stone Ages!!! President DJT." The Source: This story includes information from the White House and previous FOX 5 reporting. Iran WarPoliticsDonald J. TrumpIranNews
